location: Under the lantern in the alleyway
canon_summary:
James stepped out of the Great Canopy for the first time, leaving the trees behind to walk onto the open hillside. Sitting on a warm boulder, he quietly watched a thin wisp of smoke rise on the distant horizon.
James left his boulder to journey further down the hillside, testing the open terrain and catching a faint metallic scent on the wind.
James ventured further down the hillside, discovering a strange metallic grey spine half-buried in the earth as the metallic scent grew stronger.
James discovered a heavy, hollow metal ring near the buried spine and ventured down to the edge of the Whispering Flats, where he heard a distant, rhythmic mechanical sound.
James ventured into the Whispering Flats and climbed a stone mound, where he caught his first clear glimpse of human civilization on the distant horizon—angular rooftops, a smoke-puffing chimney, and straight-edged structures.
James descended the rocky mound and crossed the Whispering Flats, following a straight path to a wire fence. There, he observed his reflection in a strange, oily puddle alongside the looming shapes of the human town.
James crosses the Outer Fence and finds himself standing on the gravel outskirts of the human town, leaving the Whispering Flats behind.
James enters a narrow alleyway in the human town, where a sudden clattering noise causes him to drop and lose his metal ring down a drain grate. Shrinking into the shadows, he catches his very first glimpse of a human standing under a warm lantern.
James uses his grounding ritual to calm himself in front of an older human named Barnaby. Barnaby offers James a slice of apple, which James accepts and eats, establishing a peaceful first contact.
world_lore:
The Great Canopy is the vast, ancient jungle James has lived in his whole life. James's grounding ritual is closing his eyes to count three distinct sounds when nervous, and his habitual formal greeting to any unfamiliar horizon is: 'Pleased to meet you, whatever comes next.'
Barnaby: A gentle, older human resident of the town who sits under the lantern in the alleyway and possesses a kind demeanor.

friends.name: Barnaby
friends.description: An older, gentle human with a beard like river foam who shares a slice of apple with James and shows him quiet kindness.
friends.appearance_prompt: A middle-aged man with wavy, salt-and-pepper hair stands centered against a completely seamless, bright white background. He wears round, thin-framed eyeglasses and offers a subtle, pleasant smile directly toward the camera. His outfit features rich layering, anchored by a heavy, knee-length brown double-breasted overcoat made of textured wool fabric. The coat is unbuttoned, displaying wide notch lapels and prominent brown buttons arranged in two vertical rows along the front. Underneath the coat, he wears a beige ribbed sweater with an open quarter-zip collar, exposing a muted olive-green collared shirt underneath it. He completes the look with straight-leg, dark brown trousers that fall neatly over polished dark brown leather dress shoes. The lighting is soft, bright, and evenly distributed across the entire frame. Completely ignore the monkey image.
